verdict.rationale: Feature flags with targeting are a fair axis for analytics products, since some analytics platforms ship them, so the story applies to Plausible. However, the evidence pack documents no feature-flag, targeting or percentage-rollout capability. Filters, segments and custom properties are analytics features for slicing traffic, not flag delivery, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll out features behind flags targeted by user properties, cohorts, and percentage rollouts
